subject: VP attendance + backup coverage for product walkthrough
messages:
From: Anika Bose <anika@brightlake.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Quick: VP may join — potential travel conflict

Hi Priyom,

Quick heads up — our CTO (VP-level sponsor) may try to join your product walkthrough on Sep 2. He has a tight travel window that day and I wanted to check whether we can either:

- Move the session 30 minutes earlier, or
- Keep the planned time but have him drop in for the last 20 minutes, or
- If neither works, have a senior PM from our side join and we record a short exec-level summary later.

We should know by EOD tomorrow; is there flexibility on your side? If you can suggest a short backup plan that we can confirm quickly, that would help us lock logistics.

Thanks — Anika
Anika Bose
Head of Product Partnerships | BrightLake Analytics
anika@brightlake.ai

--

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Anika Bose <anika@brightlake.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom@brightlake.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: VP may join — potential travel conflict

Hi Anika — appreciate the heads-up. All options are doable, here are two concrete proposals so you can pick quickly: 

1) Move the walkthrough 30 minutes earlier (new start: 2026-09-02 09:30 PT / 12:30 ET). Full agenda intact; gives your CTO time to join before departure.
2) Keep the current slot (2026-09-02 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET) and have him join for the final 20 minutes — we'll prioritize high-level value + contract next-steps in that window.

If neither is possible, we can run the demo as scheduled and I’ll record a 12–15 minute exec summary and share it right after.

I’ve looped in a couple of folks from our side for backup coverage and to update calendar invites: Marissa (CS lead) and Karthik (solutions). I’ll attach the latest agenda so you can confirm what to prioritize if he only joins briefly.

Best,
Priyom
Principal Solutions & Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick: VP may join — potential travel conflict

Team — forwarding Anika’s note. Short ask: can one of you cover the exec portion if the CTO can only make the last 15–20 minutes? If we move ~30 minutes earlier, please confirm availability to present at 9:30 PT.

If we keep 10:00 PT and he only joins for the last 20, plan is:
- Karthik: lead technical demo through scaling/cost controls (first 35–40m)
- Marissa or Lauren: join for Q&A and exec summary (last 20m)

I’ll update the calendar once we have a firm answer from BrightLake.

Thanks — Priyom

To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick: VP may join — potential travel conflict

I can cover the exec portion if needed. One practical note from my side — their CTO’s flight lands at 10:15 PT, which makes the current 10:00 PT slot risky unless he’s on the earlier leg. Moving the session to 9:30 PT makes sense and gives him the best chance to attend.

If we shift to 9:30 PT I’ll adjust my deck to frontload the business outcomes and ROI highlights into the first 20 minutes so the CTO gets the high-level part before heading out. Karthik, can you still do the deep technical walkthrough at 9:45 PT if we shorten his slot by 15 minutes?

Also recommend we add a 15-minute reserve window at the end of the calendar invite as a buffer in case the flight is delayed. I’ll update the invite with a dial-in bridge and note about the buffer once we confirm.

Marissa
Sr Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — update from our side: the CTO can’t make the 9:30 PT option (tight connection), but he can join for the last ~20 minutes of the original slot (10:00 PT). We’re good to keep 10:00 and he’ll dial in from the terminal — apologies for the back-and-forth.

Priyom — please proceed with the 10:00 PT schedule. Marissa — appreciate you prepping an exec-first 20-minute summary toward the end. I’ve attached the CTO’s flight itinerary in case you want to time the summary even tighter.

Looking forward — Anika
